== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Fathom Planetary [[Security]] is a major defensive organization based on the planet Fathom, which serves as the headquarters for the [[Galactic Union]] and is considered a central hub of culture and economy. The agency's official mandate extends to ensuring security across the galaxy rather than being restricted to specific territories. During times of crisis, such as a state of emergency, the organization is capable of mobilizing significant resources, including private corporate troops. Its fleet consists of numerous ships equipped with subspace drives, and its defensive capabilities are noted to be superior to those of other planets like [[Zykaros]]. The organization is led by a [[Security]] Chief, though high-level operations may be managed by other officials such as the Vice Chief of Planetary Security{{!}}Vice Chief. In combat scenarios, its forces have been known to coordinate with volunteer vessels to intercept threats like [[The Last Horizon]].}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Fathom Planetary [[Security]] is an organization led by a Vice Chief of Planetary Security{{!}}Vice Chief, described as a plump woman who travels with drones. Although the group utilizes ships equipped with [[Subspace Drives]], they are considered to have no business in their current location. Following an official announcement of a state of emergency, the organization was eventually held off by [[Varic Vallenar]] acting alone.}}
